headlines.title: Western Digital Plummets 20% Over a Month: This Wall Street Team Now Predicts 230% Gains After Earnings Re-Rating
headlines.summary: Western Digital beat earnings, raised guidance, and still watched its shares crater as a rival's weak outlook spooked the market. One analyst sees a rare setup in the wreckage, but a cyclical risk could turn a cheap stock into a trap.

headlines.title: Elite Growth Stocks To Own In November 2026
headlines.summary: US inflation running at 3.8% keeps interest rates in focus and puts real pressure on weaker balance sheets. Stronger businesses with healthy finances and room for earnings to grow can look more attractive when money stays expensive. That is the idea behind this group of financially sound, high growth hopefuls. This article walks through three standout stocks from that pool and why they might deserve a spot on your watchlist.

headlines.title: Western Digital Stocks Sink 7.42%, Trading 139% Above GF Value
headlines.summary: Western Digital guided to up to 72% revenue growth, but GuruFocus flags the shares as significantly overvalued even after the drop.

headlines.title: Sandisk vs. Western Digital: Which Computer Drive Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Sandisk's revenue nearly tripled in FY 2026 while Western Digital leans heavily on cloud customers, but only one of these stocks trades at a lower forward multiple.

headlines.title: Western Digital (WDC) Stock Appears Undervalued Following Its 7x Three Year Run
headlines.summary: Western Digital has delivered extremely strong multi year gains, yet its recent pullbacks and brisk trading around AI related headlines leave a straightforward question for investors: Is the current share price properly grounded in the earnings the storage specialist is generating today and is expected to produce over time? Over the past 3 years the stock has returned roughly 7x, which puts a lot of weight on whether the underlying earnings profile can carry that kind of move.

description: Western Digital Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive (HDD) technology in the United States, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers internal HDDs, data center drives, data center platforms, external drives, portable drives, NAS for home and office, and accessories. It sells its data storage devices and solutions through its computer sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. The company has a collaboration with Open Quantum Design for the development of quantum error correction technology and related systems to advance reliable quantum computing. Western Digital Corporation was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
